targetRepo.description: Absolute path of the target repo that was assessed.

ran.description: The harnessability-assessment skill executed against the target repo.

reportDir.description: The .harness/reports/harnessability/ directory written inside the target repo.

finalGrade.description: The v0.2 final_grade A-F if present.

reportFilesExist.description: report.md / report.json / summary.md exist under the run dir.

latestJsonPresent.description: Root .harness/reports/harnessability/latest.json exists and is readable (the 008 sentinel).

runDirPresent.description: A per-run <ordinal>-<slug>/ history dir exists alongside the root latest.* files.

tupleAndGradePresent.description: The two-axis Operate-Today/Adaptability tuple AND a letter grade are present in the report.

claimsSpotChecked.description: 2-3 evidence claims were independently cross-checked against the real tree and held.

notes.description: Any per-check detail, especially for failures.

verdict.description: PASS only if the skill ran AND every validation check passed (report files + sentinel + history dir + schema + tuple/grade + spot-checked claims).

magicWand.description: The single highest-leverage change. Be specific.

magicWandTarget.description: Which system the magic wand targets: the harnessability-assessment skill, or minih itself.

category.description: build | config | data | test | debug | knowledge | other
